source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の追加分。ユーザーが別に生成した 1254x1254 の画像。タイルは画像の色をそのまま使い (mean なし)、1 枚の絵は crop で余白を切り落とす
style: Upper floors and street details of a bright space-habitat city. Each cell is ONE item seen straight on (or a flat top-down surface), flat even light, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-facade-window
cells.prompt: An apartment window seen from the street outside: white frame, half-drawn curtains, warm room light inside, a small potted plant on the sill.

cells.name: mg-balcony
cells.prompt: The front of a small apartment balcony: frosted glass panel with a slim metal handrail on top.

cells.name: mg-facade-wall
cells.prompt: Outer wall of an apartment block: small light beige rectangular tiles with thin grout, front-on.

cells.name: mg-signboard-wood
cells.prompt: A blank wooden shop sign board with a simple frame, no letters.

cells.name: mg-signboard-metal
cells.prompt: A blank enamelled metal sign board bolted at the corners, cream colour with a thin coloured border, no letters.

cells.name: mg-floor-arrow
cells.prompt: Floor guide band seen from above: yellow painted arrows in a row on grey floor paint, slightly worn.

cells.name: mg-genkan
cells.prompt: Japanese entrance floor (genkan) from above: exposed-aggregate washed stone, small grey and brown pebbles set in mortar.

cells.name: mg-shaft-door

cells.name: mg-stair
